meta.title: CleanDrone — Drone Facade Cleaning in Tampa Bay
meta.description: Safe, fast and affordable building facade cleaning with drones. Serving Tampa Bay, Florida.

hero.title: Drone-powered facade cleaning for modern buildings
hero.subtitle: We clean exteriors up to 60% faster, with no scaffolding and no risk for your team. Get a free quote in under 24 hours.

benefits.title: Why drone cleaning
benefits.subtitle: Less risk, less downtime, lower cost.

items.title: Safer for everyone
items.body: Our pilots stay on the ground. No suspended platforms over pedestrians, no scaffolding to permit.

items.title: Faster turnaround
items.body: We can clean a 20-story facade in a single day, with minimal disruption for tenants.

items.title: Lower cost
items.body: No scaffolding rentals, no extended labor, no road closures. You pay for the clean, not the setup.

items.title: Eco-friendly
items.body: We use purified water and biodegradable detergents. Up to 70% less water than pressure washing.

services.title: What we clean
services.subtitle: Tailored programs for every building type in Tampa Bay.

items.title: Office buildings & high-rises
items.body: Glass curtain walls, mullions and signage. Annual or quarterly programs available.

items.title: Hotels & resorts
items.body: Keep guest-facing exteriors spotless without disrupting check-in or pool areas.

items.title: Hospitals & schools
items.body: Low-noise, low-impact cleaning during off-hours with strict safety protocols.

items.title: Condominiums & HOAs
items.body: Restore curb appeal and protect property values with scheduled maintenance.

items.title: Solar panel arrays
items.body: Recover lost output by removing dust, salt and bird droppings from rooftop arrays.

items.title: Industrial & warehouses
items.body: Metal cladding, signage and high-bay surfaces cleaned in a single visit.

process.title: How it works
process.subtitle: From first call to clean facade in less than two weeks.

steps.title: 1. Tell us about your building
steps.body: Fill the form with the address, height and a few photos. We respond within 24 hours.

steps.title: 2. Free site assessment
steps.body: Our team visits the property, confirms scope and prepares a fixed-price quote.

steps.title: 3. Cleaning day
steps.body: Certified pilots execute the job with FAA-compliant equipment and full insurance.

steps.title: 4. Before/after report
steps.body: You receive a photo and video report of the work, ready to share with stakeholders.

gallery.title: Before & after
gallery.subtitle: Real results from buildings around Tampa Bay.

items.q: Is drone cleaning safe for my windows and facade?
items.a: Yes. We use soft-bristle systems and calibrated pressure for each surface, from glass to painted concrete.

items.q: Do you have insurance and FAA authorization?
items.a: All our pilots are FAA Part 107 certified and we carry $2M general liability insurance.

items.q: How tall a building can you clean?
items.a: We currently service buildings up to 400 ft (around 35 stories). Taller projects on request.

items.q: Will tenants need to leave the building?
items.a: No. We coordinate windows-closed notices and work in zones, with minimal disruption.
Pricing depends on facade type, height and access. Most jobs start at $0.30 per sq ft of facade.
